lessons_used: Evidence is still thin across all kinds of changes, as no kind of change has at least 2 tests yet to establish a pattern.
Predictions have consistently been too high compared to measured and noise-corrected results.
Sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder) won and was helpful, but evidence remains thin with only 1 test.
Adding a pet preview screen (adoption, new_screen) showed no clear effect.

candidates.title: Grid pet selection layout
candidates.change: Redesign the friend pick screen into a two-column grid layout displaying pet personality traits and live preview cards.
candidates.why: Adoption step has low conversion (60.9%) and long mean time (1017s), indicating users struggle to evaluate pet options.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Select a friend to keep you company while you work or play.

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Interactive story intro flow
candidates.change: Transform the intro story screen into an interactive scroll flow where users select companion goals before choosing their creation path.
candidates.why: Choose path drops 23.8% of users with an average duration of 514s, showing early onboarding friction.

story.headline: A New Companion Awaits
story.body: Scroll to discover how your desktop pet will assist, entertain, and interact with you daily.

guard.reason: Story screen redesign retains its purpose of introducing the pet.

candidates.score_note: High cost new flow targeting moderate choose_path drop without support email backing.

candidates.title: Pet companion control tutorial screen
candidates.change: Add a new preparation screen during the waiting step that introduces basic desktop controls like hiding, positioning, and chatting.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple support emails about confusion over controlling and hiding desktop pets after setup.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Space
waiting.body: Your companion is getting ready. Review the desktop control tips below while you wait.

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_control_guide']

candidates.title: Desktop companion spotlight welcome
candidates.change: Redesign the final home welcome screen into a spotlight view showcasing shortcut keys and interaction modes.
candidates.why: Finish step drop-off is 35.2% and users report confusion on how to interact with the pet post-onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Click and drag to position your pet. Right-click anytime to hide or open companion settings.

guard.reason: Redesigning the home_intro overlay is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from both 35.2% finish drop-off and post-onboarding support tickets.

candidates.title: Account persistence reassurance copy
candidates.change: Add explicit reassurance copy to the sign-in screen confirming that account sign-in securely saves pet progress across devices.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails reporting missing pets or account resets after signing back in.

sign_in.headline: Save & Protect Your Companion
sign_in.body: Sign in to back up your custom pet, settings, and unlock seamless multi-device sync.
sign_in.hint: Your pet progress will automatically link to your account.

guard.reason: Adding account persistence reassurance copy to sign-in screen is valid.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost copy fix with strong evidence from 8 account loss support emails.

candidates.title: Custom photo generation hint
candidates.change: Add photo quality guidance and lighting hints on the photo upload screen.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or incorrect visual outcomes.

upload_photos.hint: Use clear, well-lit photos facing forward for best AI pet generation results.

guard.reason: Adding photo guidance hints to photo upload screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Targets highest drop step (adoption, 39.1%) supported by ticket reports at low copy cost.

candidates.title: Generation status tip carousel
candidates.change: Display a dynamic tip carousel and status text while waiting for pet assets to generate.
candidates.why: The waiting phase on the home step has high mean time (2336s), leading to user drop-off.

guard.reason: Adding dynamic tip carousel and generation status text to waiting screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high wait time on home step, but evidence relies solely on funnel duration.

candidates.title: Desktop notification readiness alert
candidates.change: Enable desktop notification toggle on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet rendering finishes.
candidates.why: Mean wait time is 2336s (~38 mins), indicating users minimize the app and forget to return.

waiting.body: We will send a quick desktop alert as soon as your companion is ready to meet you!

guard.reason: Adding notification readiness alert on waiting screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Directly targets long mean wait time (~38 min) to recover lost home step users.

candidates.title: Adoption certificate badge seal
candidates.change: Add an official companion badge component and reward sound trigger to the adoption certificate screen.
candidates.why: Adoption step conversion is only 60.9%, needing stronger emotional payoff to encourage completion.

guard.reason: Adding a companion badge seal and celebration chime to adoption certificate preserves step purpose.

candidates.score_note: Targets largest drop step (adoption 39.1%) with reward UI, though evidence is funnel-only.

candidates.title: Post-certificate sign in reorder
candidates.change: Move the sign-in step to occur immediately after certificate viewing rather than after asset waiting.
candidates.why: Moving sign-in after adoption proved successful in earlier tests; placing it right after certificate generation secures account commitment while motivation is highest.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in to occur after adoption certificate is explicitly allowed.

candidates.score_note: High confidence step reorder backed by previous winning test (+2.8% lift) at low config cost.

lessons_next: Predictions continue to be consistently too high compared to measured and noise-corrected results.
Sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder) is helpful, averaging +2.2% after noise correction across 2 tests, with 1 test winning.
Evidence is still thin for adding new adoption screens (adoption, new_screen) with only 1 test, which showed no clear effect.
